description: The app talks HTTP to its engine; through Tauri it asks the shell for the installed fonts and the native GPU canvas, and on macOS sets its menus in the system menu bar (core:default includes the core menu permissions); the open and save panels (1.87.0) let the person choose where projects and exports go. The window shows the page the engine serves on 127.0.0.1, a remote origin to Tauri, so the capability lists that address and every app command has an allow permission (build.rs); core:default already holds the event permissions the page uses to hear about opened files and quit requests.
